top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards general, ligand-controlled palladium-catalysed C-N cross-coupling to Buchwald and Hartwig alone. The advance is mechanism-guided ligand design (oxidative addition, amine binding, reductive elimination) that turned a narrow, harsh reaction into a routine one, with three decades of independent confirmation in pharmaceutical, agrochemical and materials synthesis. It is a simple concept with proven consequences, and the two-name attribution is clean because Kosugi's stoichiometric tin-amide reaction was a precursor and not the general method. A single part keeps the citation tight and avoids diluting it.
